```{shinylive-python}
from shiny import App, render, ui, reactive
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.tags.style("""
        .region-container {
            border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;

            padding-bottom: 8px;
        }

            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: #64748b;
            background-color: #f8fafc;

    """),

    ui.tags.section(
        {"id": "section-scenario", "role": "region", "aria-labelledby": "heading-scenario", "class": "region-container"},
        ui.tags.h2({"id": "heading-scenario", "class": "region-header"}, "1. Scenario Selection"),
        ui.tags.p("Select the basecalling model and sequencing depth matching your experiment. Selections begin unset."),
        ui.layout_columns(
            ui.input_select(
                "model_select",
                "Basecalling Model",
                {"": "-- Select Basecalling Model --", "hac": "HAC (High Accuracy)", "sup": "SUP (Super Accurate)"},
                selected="",
            ),
            ui.input_select(
                "depth_select",
                "Sequencing Depth",
                {"": "-- Select Sequencing Depth --", "20x": "20× Depth", "100x": "100× Depth"},
                selected="",
            ),
            col_widths=(6, 6)
        ),
        ui.output_ui("scenario_validation_msg")
    ),

    # Region 2: Priorities and Weights
    ui.tags.section(
        {"id": "section-priorities", "role": "region", "aria-labelledby": "heading-priorities", "class": "region-container"},
        ui.tags.h2({"id": "heading-priorities", "class": "region-header"}, "2. Priorities & Eligibility Requirements"),
        ui.tags.p("Choose a published starting preset or define custom percentage priorities totaling 100%."),
        ui.layout_columns(
            ui.input_select(
                "preset_select",
                "Preference Preset",
                {
                    "community_balanced": "Community-balanced (28% Acc, 20% Contig, 17% Res, 35% Repl)",
                    "complete_replicon_recovery": "Complete-replicon-recovery (Gate: all replicons ≥95%)",
                    "sequence_accurate_assembly": "Sequence-accurate-assembly (50% Acc, 14% Contig, 12% Res, 24% Repl)",
                    "custom": "Custom Priorities"
                },
                selected="community_balanced"
            ),
            ui.output_ui("preset_description"),
            col_widths=(6, 6)
        ),
        ui.tags.div(
            {"role": "group", "aria-labelledby": "weights-label"},
            ui.tags.span({"id": "weights-label", "class": "sr-only"}, "Criterion percentage weights"),
            ui.layout_columns(
                ui.input_numeric("w_acc", "Sequence Accuracy (%)", value=28, min=0, max=100, step=1),
                ui.input_numeric("w_cont", "Reference Contiguity (%)", value=20, min=0, max=100, step=1),
                ui.input_numeric("w_res", "Residual Adapter Removal (%)", value=17, min=0, max=100, step=1),
                ui.input_numeric("w_rep", "Replicon Recovery (%)", value=35, min=0, max=100, step=1),

    ui.tags.section(

        ui.tags.p("Detailed per-isolate performance, warnings, and error-event breakdown for the selected tool combination:"),
        ui.output_ui("selected_combo_detail")

        ui.tags.p(

            "(1) Reference-aware contiguity via symmetric distance from auNGA ratio 1.0; "
            "(2) Sequence accuracy via combined mismatch-plus-indel event rate (0 at ≥10 events/100kbp); "
            "(3) Residual adapter/barcode removal via cohort clean-isolate percentage; "
            "(4) Reference-replicon recovery via cohort absolute count of replicons <50% coverage with fixed denominator 3."
        ),
        ui.tags.div(
            {"class": "provenance-box"},
            ui.tags.strong("Scoring Version: "), "1.0 | ",
            ui.tags.strong("Source Repository: "), "adimascf/biox7021 | ",
            ui.tags.strong("Pinned Commit: "), "4d6b8cb1d482e5066f9ca575ebd3b67af4a32562 | ",
            ui.tags.strong("Scope: "), "13 bacterial reference isolates, 17 QC–trimming combinations (884 observations)"
        )
    )
)

def server(input, output, session):

    @reactive.Calc
    def load_metrics_data():
        # Load pinned benchmark data bundled with the site or fallback to pinned commit
        try:
            return pd.read_csv("assets/data/assembly_metrics.csv")
        except Exception:
            try:
                return pd.read_csv("assembly_metrics.csv")
            except Exception:
                from pyodide.http import open_url
                pinned_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adimascf/biox7021/4d6b8cb1d482e5066f9ca575ebd3b67af4a32562/logbook/assembly_metrics.csv"
                return pd.read_csv(open_url(pinned_url))

    @output
    @render.ui
    def scenario_validation_msg():
        m = input.model_select()
        d = input.depth_select()
        if not m or not d:
            return ui.HTML("<div class='alert alert-info' role='alert'><strong>Notice:</strong> Please select both a basecalling model and sequencing depth to view recommendations.</div>")
        return ui.HTML(f"<div class='alert alert-success' role='status'>Active Scenario: <strong>{m.upper()}</strong> basecalling at <strong>{d}</strong> depth.</div>")

    @output
    @render.ui
    def preset_description():
        p = input.preset_select()
        descriptions = {
            "community_balanced": "Community-balanced: 28% sequence accuracy, 20% reference contiguity, 17% residual removal, 35% replicon recovery.",
            "complete_replicon_recovery": "Complete-replicon-recovery: Enforces ≥95% coverage on all reference replicons; ranks eligible tools with 43% accuracy, 31% contiguity, 26% residual removal.",
            "sequence_accurate_assembly": "Sequence-accurate-assembly: Prioritizes base-level sequence fidelity with 50% accuracy weight.",
            "custom": "Custom Priorities: Specify your own percentage weights totaling 100% and toggle non-compensatory gates."
        }
        desc = descriptions.get(p, "")
        return ui.tags.div({"class": "alert alert-secondary", "style": "margin-bottom: 0; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.9rem;"}, desc)

    @output
    @render.ui
    def weight_total_indicator():
        w1 = input.w_acc() or 0
        w2 = input.w_cont() or 0
        w3 = input.w_res() or 0
        w4 = input.w_rep() or 0
        total = w1 + w2 + w3 + w4
        diff = total - 100
        if diff == 0:
            return ui.HTML("<div style='color: #16a34a; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 4px;'>✓ Total: <strong>100%</strong></div>")
        elif diff < 0:
            return ui.HTML(f"<div style='color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 4px;'>⚠ Total: <strong>{total}%</strong> ({abs(diff)}% remaining to allocate)</div>")
        else:
            return ui.HTML(f"<div style='color: #dc2626; font-size: 0.9rem; margin-top: 4px;'>⚠ Total: <strong>{total}%</strong> ({diff}% above 100%)</div>")

    @output
    @render.data_frame
    def ranking_table():
        m = input.model_select()
        d = input.depth_select()
        if not m or not d:
            empty_df = pd.DataFrame(columns=["Rank", "Combination", "Preference Score", "Contiguity", "Accuracy", "Residual Removal", "Replicon Recovery"])
            return empty_df

        df = load_metrics_data()
        subset = df[(df["model"] == m) & (df["depth"] == d)]
        
        # Placeholder summary table for initial foundation
        records = []
        for combo, grp in subset.groupby("combo"):
            mean_cont = float(np.mean(np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - np.abs(grp["auNGA_ratio"] - 1.0)) * 100.0))
            mean_acc = float(np.mean(np.clip(1.0 - (grp["Mismatches per 100kbp"] + grp["Indels per 100kbp"]) / 10.0, 0.0, 1.0) * 100.0))
            clean_pct = float(np.mean(grp["contamination_count"] == 0) * 100.0)
            t_miss = int(grp["total_missed"].sum())
            score_rep = float(max(0.0, 1.0 - t_miss / 3.0) * 100.0)
            
            w_acc = (input.w_acc() or 0) / 100.0
            w_cont = (input.w_cont() or 0) / 100.0
            w_res = (input.w_res() or 0) / 100.0
            w_rep = (input.w_rep() or 0) / 100.0
            total_w = w_acc + w_cont + w_res + w_rep
            if total_w == 0:
                overall = 0.0
            else:
                overall = (w_acc * mean_acc + w_cont * mean_cont + w_res * clean_pct + w_rep * score_rep) / total_w
                
            records.append({
                "Combination": combo,
                "Preference Score": round(overall, 1),
                "Contiguity": round(mean_cont, 1),
                "Accuracy": round(mean_acc, 1),
                "Residual Removal": round(clean_pct, 1),
                "Replicon Recovery": round(score_rep, 1)
            })
            
        res_df = pd.DataFrame(records).sort_values(by="Preference Score", ascending=False)
        res_df.insert(0, "Rank", range(1, len(res_df) + 1))
        return res_df.head(5)

    @output
    @render.ui
    def excluded_combinations_ui():
        return ui.HTML("<details><summary style='cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500;'>Excluded / Ineligible Combinations (0)</summary><p style='margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #64748b;'>All 17 combinations are currently eligible under active criteria.</p></details>")

    @output
    @render.ui
    def selected_combo_detail():
        return ui.HTML("<div class='text-muted' style='font-size: 0.95rem; font-style: italic;'>Select a combination from the shortlist above to inspect per-isolate evidence, warnings, and diagnostic breakdowns.</div>")

app = App(app_ui, server)
```
